description: Ministry of Defence - Extradition Law, No. 8 of 1977 order under section 3
reasoning: This gazette content is an order under the Extradition Law, No. 8 of 1977, declaring that a treaty between Sri Lanka and the United Arab Emirates is in conformity with the law and that the provisions of the Extradition Law shall apply to the UAE. This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter involving the application of existing law to international agreements, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
